g.text: Smaller execution families: admission and held-out risk

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Same fixed25 Q1 fits; original120 market paths repeated five times. Each fit decides before its24 evaluation returns.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Annual and TV rules are diagnostic controls; neither estimates per-trade benefit>cost for a final Q2 strategy.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: B inclusion makes supported training feasibility mechanical; only separate inner and held-out observations bear on risk.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Conditional cohorts differ. Zero admission has NULL risk; the 10% reference is not a future guarantee.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Repeat labels are partitions, not time. No best seed/architecture, confidence interval or effective N=600 is inferred.
